question: What proportional measure is prescribed for the ground level in this construction?
premises: The ground level (dharātala) is the element being specified.
Its measure is prescribed as a fourth part less by one quarter.
This measure is authoritatively declared in the text.
inference: Therefore the ground level is prescribed to measure three-quarters of the relevant unit.
uncertainties: The exact reference unit for the three-quarter measure depends on the preceding verses' context.
plain_english: But the ground level is declared to be three-quarters in measure.
